name: Enchanted Bow
text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Exhaust Enchanted Bow: Fight. You must use either [willpower] or [agility] instead of [combat] and get +1 skill value for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to have this attack target a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location; if you do, ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack.
text_cn: 使用(3充能)。 [action]消耗附魔弓：攻击。你这次攻击+1技能值，并且必须不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]或[agility]。这次攻击造成+1伤害。作为发动本能力的额外费用，你可以花费1充能来使这次攻击以连接地点的一名非[[精英]]敌人为目标；如果你这么做，这次攻击忽略冷漠和反击关键词。
